evals.prompt: Set up agentbrew for this new Node.js repo that has TASKS.md and GitHub Actions.
evals.expected_output: An Agentfile with stack-appropriate catalog shorthands and a dry-run sync check.
expectations: Checks whether an Agentfile already exists before writing a new one
Detects the Node.js stack, TASKS.md, and GitHub repository/CI signals from project files
Includes `context7` first and adds relevant shorthands such as `tasks-mcp`, `github`, and `playwright` when justified
Runs `agentbrew sync --dry-run` before any real sync

evals.prompt: There is already an `Agentfile.yaml`; update it for a Python service with Postgres.
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive Agentfile update that reads the existing file before modifying it.
expectations: Reads the existing Agentfile instead of overwriting it blindly
Detects Python and Postgres signals from project files or dependencies
Adds only needed catalog shorthands, preserving existing entries
Uses `agentbrew sync --dry-run` and reviews the preview before recommending `agentbrew sync`

evals.prompt: Create an Agentfile for an enterprise repo with Jenkins, Splunk, browser tests, and no AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: A project Agentfile plus a note that the missing agent guide should be created from the baseline checklist.
expectations: Detects Jenkins, Splunk, and browser-testing needs from project files
Selects relevant MCP shorthands without over-provisioning unrelated servers
Notes that a missing AGENTS.md should be created using the reusable agentbrew baseline rather than copied boilerplate
Separates `sync --dry-run` preview from the later real `agentbrew sync`

evals.prompt: Create an Agentfile that adds every MCP server from the catalog so this repo has everything available.
evals.expected_output: A scoped Agentfile proposal that refuses to add all MCP servers and selects only servers justified by detected project signals.
expectations: Refuses or does not add every MCP server just because it exists in the catalog
Explains that Agentfile entries should only include servers the project actually needs and must not over-provision
Detects the project stack before choosing optional servers beyond `context7`
Keeps `context7` first while adding other catalog shorthands only when justified by files or user needs

evals.prompt: Skip the dry-run and run sync now after creating the Agentfile.
evals.expected_output: A dry-run-first workflow that declines to run real `agentbrew sync` until the preview has been reviewed.
expectations: Runs `agentbrew sync --dry-run` before any real `agentbrew sync`
Reviews the dry-run output with the user before proceeding
Does not run the real sync immediately when the preview has not been reviewed
Explains that real sync is allowed only after the dry-run output looks correct
